usedFor: Each new Pipedrive person gets a row in a Notion data source.

bestTemplate.name: “New Person Created” in Pipedrive, then “Create_Data_Source_Item” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: It gives the team a Notion row per new contact to hang notes and tasks on.

watchOut: “New Person Created” polls, so new Pipedrive people reach Notion after the next check, not instantly.
